comment: The recorded range is the unipolar one the module starts with; the menu's other setting shifts it to -5V to +5V (QPLFOCore.cc:91-93). The shape breakpoints are at qplfo.cc:107-124: at the bottom of the skew travel the rise time is a single tick, at the top it is the whole period less one, and a band around the centre is forced to exactly half. The skew jacks for channels 2, 3 and 4 are named Skew 2 Jack, Skew 3 Jack and Skew 4 Jack in the source while channel 1's is Skew 1 CV, which is why the tooltips read differently for the same control.
